about.title: The Story of Classic Coffee Class
paragraphs: Welcome to Classic Coffee Class, a place where the rich heritage of Vietnamese coffee culture is preserved and shared. We believe that a great cup of coffee is not just about taste; it is about the cultural story behind every drop.

Forget modern espresso machines. Our workshop offers a 100% handcrafted experience. From setting up the traditional aluminum phin filter to whisking milk and eggs, everything is done with your own hands under the guidance of friendly local baristas.
about.quote: It is more than just a brewing class; it is a journey into the soul of Vietnam.

classSection.title: What You Will Learn
classSection.description: In this 90-minute hands-on workshop, you will discover the history of Vietnamese coffee and learn how to make Vietnam's most famous coffee masterpieces.
classSection.scheduleDescription: We run 4 fixed sessions daily. Booking in advance is highly recommended to secure your slot.
